items.summary: A U.K. drug marketing watchdog has slammed CSL Seqirus for “multiple and prolonged deficiencies” in its systems, governance and oversight.

items.title: Melissa explains it all in menopause team up with Bayer
items.summary: Bayer is teaming up with American actress and director Melissa Joan Hart to boost awareness about hot flashes treatment Lynkuet by tapping her personal experiences.

items.title: Theramex pays up to $250M for Asieris' novel cervical lesion treatment
items.summary: Should an EU approval go through, the deal allows Asieris to piggyback its global expansion on Theramex’s established women’s health infrastructure across Europe.

items.title: PhRMA launches new legal challenge as CMS brings 'most favored nation' pricing to Medicare Part B
items.summary: As the Trump administration advances plans to bring its “most favored nation” drug pricing model to Medicare Part B, the pharmaceutical industry’s top lobbying group is pushing back in court.

items.title: Sanofi drafts NY Knicks star Karl-Anthony Towns for COVID, Nuvaxovid awareness push
items.summary: New York Knicks champ Karl-Anthony Towns is sharing his personal experience with COVID to encourage others to talk with their doctors about vaccination options.

items.title: Novartis' Rhapsido tackles 2 most common forms of chronic hives with swift FDA expansion
items.summary: A little over a year after landing its flagship approval in chronic hives, Novartis’ oral BTK inhibitor Rhapsido is expanding its reach with a new FDA nod that comes with a notable ‘first’ for the field.

items.title: Halozyme stymies subcutaneous Keytruda launch in select European countries as Merck vows to fight patent claims
items.summary: After facing a setback in Germany late last year, Merck & Co.’s European marketing plans for its below-the-skin Keytruda SC are growing more complicated.

items.title: New API Innovation Center index spotlights supply chain stress points
items.summary: The National Fragility Index, launched by the API Innovation Center, warned that more than 550 million prescriptions filled in the U.S. in 2023 were categorized as being highly or severely vulnerable to supply chain interruptions.

items.title: How drugmakers are tapping into the GLP-1 frenzy's unprecedented 'consumer overlay'
items.summary: With the advent of powerful GLP-1 medications from Novo and Eli Lilly, the conversation about obesity as a chronic disease has begun to shift, along with the understanding of how tackling weight can trigger a multitude of downstream health benefits.

items.title: Scaling psychedelics comes with uncertainty ‘baked into the sauce’
items.summary: The possibility of psychedelic therapies for PTSD or treatment-resistant depression in the U.S. has never been greater. But even as the industry inches closer to an FDA go-ahead, the realities of approved psychedelic medicine are far from decided.

items.title: Catalent wins access to Iro and launches next-gen development platform
items.summary: Catalent will gain access to Ori's Iro platform, a proprietary automated cell and gene therapy manufacturing system that speeds up development and reduces costs.
